name: scenario_FileManager_writes_and_reads_back
description: A file written to the device is still there after a restart, which is the property every preset, script and configuration depends on. The one card whose whole job is the filesystem, so it is the one that proves the filesystem.

steps.name: write-a-file
steps.description: Write through the same path the editor uses, so this exercises what a user's save does.

steps.name: it-is-there
steps.description: Read it straight back, which proves the write returned rather than merely reported.

steps.name: restart
steps.description: Restart, because a write that only reached a cache is not a write.

steps.name: it-survived
steps.description: Still there, so the bytes reached the filesystem and came back at boot.
